canonical_project: Liberia National Data Center / Digital Fast Track Program
owner: Government of Liberia / Cybastion Institute of Technology
notes: DCD reported a September 2024 MoU to establish a new data center and subsea cable under a five-year Digital Fast Track program; later ELBC reporting said the government planned a national data center to improve digital security and protect government data. Location not publicly specified; classified under Montserrado because Liberia's national ICT policy places the primary national data center in Monrovia.
